top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver would step out of the room to go to the kitchen and leave infants unsupervised.

top_violation_types.title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection an eight month infant was observed with a blanket inside the crib.   This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The cribs at the operation did not have a labeling system that had the child's name, or as an alternative, having a labeling system with a number on the crib and a number/infant assignment map available to match with it in the room.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The nap mats were not labeled with the children names.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A list of current employees is not posted.
